# What are AI Colleagues?   [Skip link to What are AI Colleagues?](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/getting-started\#what-are-ai-colleagues)

AI Colleagues are persistent, autonomous digital workers that automate complex business processes within your organization. Unlike traditional chatbots or simple automation tools, AI Colleagues represent specialized roles (like an HR Operations Specialist or IT Coordinator) with specific responsibilities, tools, and decision-making capabilities.

# Key Components:   [Skip link to Key Components:](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/getting-started\#key-components)

- **AI Colleagues (AICs)**: Digital workers with defined responsibilities
- **Agent Operating Protocols (AOPs)**: Structured business processes
- **Tools**: Individual capabilities that can be combined to create complex workflows within AOPs
- **Workbench**: Management interface for monitoring and managing scheduled triggers for AOPs

# Key Concepts and Terminology   [Skip link to Key Concepts and Terminology](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/getting-started\#key-concepts-and-terminology)

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| **AI Colleague (AIC)** | A persistent autonomous agent representing a digital worker with a specific job role |
| **Agent Operating Protocol (AOP)** | A structured business process that defines step-by-step automation workflows |
| **AOP Executor** | System that runs AOPs and manages their execution |
| **Tools** | Individual capabilities (API calls, data processing, notifications) used within AOPs |
| **Workbench** | Dashboard for monitoring future AOP executions |
| **Escalation Manager** | Designated person to handle exceptions for AOP executions |

# User Permissions:   [Skip link to User Permissions:](https://docs.leena.ai/docs/getting-started\#user-permissions)

- **AIC Admin**: AIC configuration, AOP creation, Setting up schedules within Workbench
- **General User**: Task participation, basic interactions via Virtual Assistant
